name: Sales
intro: Sellers and sales ops specialists who fill your pipeline, close deals and keep your CRM clean.

roleDetails.text: Prospects new leads by phone, email and LinkedIn, and books qualified meetings for your closers.
Runs discovery calls and demos, handles objections and closes deals.
Manages territories, quotas, reporting and the processes that keep the sales team running smoothly.
Sets up and maintains your CRM, builds the fields and workflows, and keeps the data accurate.
Researches target accounts, builds prospect lists and enriches contact data for outreach.
